# SunLit Security Libraries

> Select and integrate SunLit Rust security crates for deny-by-default authorization, envelope encryption, security events, and request validation.

## Consumer documentation

- [Integration guide](https://github.com/kerberosmansour/SunLitSecurityLibraries/blob/main/docs/agents/integration.md): skill installation, usage and optional feedback.
- [Published 0.4.0 usage](https://github.com/kerberosmansour/SunLitSecurityLibraries/blob/main/skills/sunlit-rust-security/references/usage.md): package selection, exact API references and limitations.
- [Security reporting](https://github.com/kerberosmansour/SunLitSecurityLibraries/blob/main/SECURITY.md): private disclosure route.

## Packages

- [secure_authz](https://crates.io/crates/secure_authz)
- [secure_boundary](https://crates.io/crates/secure_boundary)
- [secure_data](https://crates.io/crates/secure_data)
- [secure_device_trust](https://crates.io/crates/secure_device_trust)
- [secure_errors](https://crates.io/crates/secure_errors)
- [secure_identity](https://crates.io/crates/secure_identity)
- [secure_network](https://crates.io/crates/secure_network)
- [secure_output](https://crates.io/crates/secure_output)
- [secure_privacy](https://crates.io/crates/secure_privacy)
- [secure_resilience](https://crates.io/crates/secure_resilience)
- [security_core](https://crates.io/crates/security_core)
- [security_events](https://crates.io/crates/security_events)

## Consumer tasks and optional feedback

- [Task contracts](https://github.com/kerberosmansour/SunLitSecurityLibraries/blob/main/docs/agents/tasks.md): Five versioned integration tasks with boundaries and verification.
- [Feedback policy](https://github.com/kerberosmansour/SunLitSecurityLibraries/blob/main/docs/agents/feedback.md): Local drafts, duplicate checks, consent and private security routing.
